body:
Opening `0222`, `0112`, `0001` or `2002` now produces exactly the owner's corrected arrangement without entering manual turns. Aligned references use straight default turns, with the same resolved values in the controls, renderer, spacing worker and image exports.

The geometric rule also handles other single references and collinear through-links. It preserves reciprocal routes, lenses, closed halves, intentional angles/bends and legacy gallery geometry. Explicit turns, including an all-zero list, survive Apply and sharing; individual resets restore the current network's default. Gap configuration, placement and the gap-reduction algorithm are unchanged.

Fixes #41

### Reproduction and verification

- Before: open `/network/?code=0222`; its target approach bends unnecessarily. Entering `turns=0 -30` removes the bend. The other three supplied URLs reproduce the symmetric cases.
- Automated regression: `src/links/issue-41.test.js` compares all four supplied arrangements, checks twenty seeded 1–3-link networks and audits every one of the 4,181 small topologies, including fixed middles, free/self halves and unchanged gaps. Editor tests cover turns, numeric drafts, resets, sharing and topology edits.
- All 977 unit tests pass. ESLint, Prettier, file limits, secret scanning, Python/Ruff/ShellCheck and the production build pass locally.
- Chromium and Firefox pass the new browser contract: 24 networks, exact default/manual SVG equality, sharing, native editing, worker spacing, Apply, real SVG download and mobile layout. CI adds WebKit/macOS alongside the inherited browser suites.
- A separate exhaustive painted-collision audit preserves all 141 previously collision-free default drawings among the 4,181 topologies. A reciprocal-routing experiment explains why those established curves are retained.

The [case study](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-41-ebf5585c69b9/docs/case-studies/issue-41/README.md) contains the complete requirement inventory, timeline, root causes, primary-source component research, solution decisions, raw data, before/after screenshots and reproducible commands. Remaining crossings in fixed layouts remain subject to the existing optional spacing solver.

### Before and after

Each card shows the original default on the left and corrected default on the right. The first four cards are the reported examples; the remaining twenty are the unchanged seeded sample.
